title: A many-to-many cardinality relationship propagates a filter on the shared column; unmatched rows get no blank row

source.quote: blank virtual rows aren't added to compensate for referential integrity violations
source.supports: a limited relationship adds no blank row for values missing on the filtering side

source.quote: The additional blank row is not added to the target of a limited relationship
a relationship is limited if it has a many-to-many cardinality or if it is a cross-island relationship
source.supports: a many-to-many cardinality relationship is limited

derivation: Clothing: Target rows 100 (2019) + 120 (2020) = 220. Accessories: 50 + 60 = 110. Target's Footwear row (30) has no Product: with a regular relationship it would appear on a blank row, but a limited relationship adds none, so the result has two rows.
notes: An engine that adds a blank row here would return a third row (BLANK, 30).
